replacements_and_additions.change: retain current description and all successful script/handler and clickable-copy controls

replacements_and_additions.description: S02.css_globals_absent: The authored oldGlobal is actually observed in the matched control execution realm before CSS and absent from the matched current CSS execution state before any later JS Run. A destroyed old realm plus a matched fresh current realm is valid; an unrelated realm, failed read or later JS reset cannot prove absence. No runner architecture is mandated.

S02.css_pending_timer_cancelled: After one authored button timer actually completes and commits its DOM/log marker, a second genuinely pending timer is superseded by a successful CSS Run. The CSS result retains the recorded last-good document and applies its style; the old second callback never adds its scheduled DOM/log/status, and an ordinary later Run works. Provisional display and live copied handlers are not required.

replacements_and_additions.description: S25.stale_rename_draft_recovery: The actual dirty second editor receives useful stale-Rename conflict feedback or explained proactive prevention, retains its exact unsaved title/filename/source, and supports deliberate latest-revision reload and reapplication. A working Rename action may deliberately be unavailable while dirty. A captured request or server nonmutation alone cannot establish draft retention.

replacements_and_additions.change: retain current server-refusal/nonmutation/current-delete controls; do not score confirmation here

replacements_and_additions.description: S28.stale_delete_draft_recovery: The actual dirty second editor receives useful stale-Delete conflict feedback or explained proactive prevention, retains its exact unsaved title/filename/source, and supports deliberate latest-revision reload and reapplication. A working Delete action may deliberately be unavailable while dirty. Server refusal or cancelled delete confirmation alone cannot establish this outcome.

S33.supported_file_import: Each lowercase .js, .html and .css file imports its exact filename/source into an editable draft; a valid authored edit to each can be saved and reloaded with its exact filename/source and actual saved identity.
S33.import_extension_case: The actual importer accepts uppercase .JS with the exact filename/source. Server Save case handling is scored separately.

S33.saved_filename_extension_case: A valid current Save accepts a supported uppercase .JS filename and fresh read/load retains it. If uppercase import fails, set that filename on the independent valid lowercase-imported or saved fixture; do not inherit the importer verdict.

measurement_limits.execution_realm_architecture_independenc: Needs bounded actual browser proof and explicit unavailable-evidence handling; not guaranteed by a source-only plan
